subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: After the helper defect and conflicts are resolved, should this PR require live Feishu/CardKit proof or may a maintainer apply a proof override based on sanctioned verification?
rationale: The external contributor says they lack a live Feishu tenant and DeepSeek streaming setup, and automation cannot verify the real CardKit path from helper output alone.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until a redacted Feishu/CardKit recording, logs, or equivalent live transcript shows streamed final chunks accumulating in the real channel.

options.title: Apply override after maintainer verification
options.body: A maintainer with the required tenant/provider setup can run equivalent verification and explicitly apply a proof override if live artifacts cannot be shared.

options.title: Fold into broader Feishu streaming work
options.body: Pause this branch and handle the latest-token case inside the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker if maintainers want one combined fix.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until a redacted Feishu/CardKit recording, logs, or equivalent live transcript shows streamed final chunks accumulating in the real channel.
